metadata.note: 45/54 stores are precisely located; 6 more are geocoded only to a town centroid (distances suppressed, not fabricated) and 3 have no coordinates at all.

approx_distance_method: Where a store has no address-level coordinate, its town centre stands in and the pair carries approx_km with approx_basis 'town_to_town' (or 'same_town'). Approximate by construction — a town is several km across — and deliberately never used for overlap_risk, which stays on measured distances only.
overlap_risk_method: overlap_risk = min(1, Σ exp(−d/1.5 km) / 4) over every other located operational own store, d in km. Distance-decay (retail gravity): a neighbour's pull falls smoothly with distance and is never cut off at a fixed radius, and the whole network contributes rather than only those inside one ring. A score of 1.00 means overlap equal to 4 stores at zero distance. Geography-only heuristic (no sales data exists to calibrate against) — a relative screening signal, not a measurement. kind: "derived". null when either input is unavailable — NEVER computed from a town-centroid coordinate.
